name: sakuradrive
description: NAS monitoring, cataloging and disaster-recovery tooling for StableBit DrivePool servers

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sakuradrive/shared && npm run build -w @sakuradrive/server && npm run build -w @sakuradrive/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @sakuradrive/server & npm run dev -w @sakuradrive/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @sakuradrive/shared && npm run test -w @sakuradrive/server && npm run test -w @sakuradrive/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sakuradrive/shared && npm run typecheck -w @sakuradrive/server && npm run typecheck -w @sakuradrive/web
